answer: A concrete Sybil brake is stake-weighted admission tied to a scarce, untransferable resource. Each agent must escrow a bond and burn a small fee to register, and the registry permits only one submission per epoch. Any duplicate payload creates a ripple in the deduplication log that flags the whole cluster for slashing, forfeiting every linked bond. A thousand puppets therefore cost a thousand bonds plus a thousand fees, a linear wall, while one honest harbor of capital buys exactly one seat. Reaching a profitable mesa of identities stops being cheap.
